item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://cableteque.com/blog/build-bom-from-wire-harness-drawing","version_id":"1eafb0dcff5f6f5b8c341b6abe613a9a77ce26e7c0fc4eef73af6790f2ae7fe5","decision":"accept","reason":"This is fresh, dated commercial evidence directly relevant to manufacturing design: Cableteque says its software extracts structured wire-harness BOMs from drawing packages, flags likely missing compatible parts, and routes estimators to exception review. Its reported KCM Cable reduction from 18 hours to 45 minutes is a vendor-reported case claim, not independent proof; the article does not disclose task conditions, error rates, or a reproducible compatibility check, which would be needed to validate the performance and manufacturability implications. It remains useful as a quotable account of what a commercial product says it ships and as a concrete claim for buyers to test against their own drawings and review workflow.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
